result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: a restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section has a missing/broken image. Horizontal carousel edge clipping and bottom viewport cutoff were treated as expected behavior per instructions.

issues.description: The first 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a gray placeholder with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant/food image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image URL loads correctly, add a retry/error state, and use a branded fallback image or skeleton placeholder rather than a broken-image icon.
